name: fast Fourier transform
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 高效计算离散傅里叶变换的算法。
usage_overview: 用于加速随机风场合成中的频域计算及频域与时域转换，也用于将车体加速度转换到频域，以便施加舒适性评价所需的频率权重。

complete_examples.text: Then, the fluctuating cross winds are simulated by the fast Fourier transform technique from spectral representations with the consideration of spatial correlation of multipoint wind time histories and vehicle movement.
